author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Upright phone with r4 corners and one r13 signal arc concentric with each top corner; a hand from the lower right: back of the hand leaving the phone edge and a 45-degree thumb (r5 3-4-5 tip) laid across the screen, its root meeting the wrist. Reads as a hand holding a phone sending a wireless signal; the before's overlapping hand outline was muddled.
omissions: The inner signal arc on each side (two arcs per side exceed the width budget) and the phone's bottom bezel line (no room under the thumb).
